introduction.title: Share SQL helpers through a URL
paragraphs: A DuckDB macro packages a reusable SQL expression or query. WebMacro loads a macro definition from an HTTP URL and registers it in the current session, allowing several notebooks or applications to use the same definition.

Use it for shared SQL helpers that you maintain in a repository or another HTTP host. Pin the URL to a reviewed revision when the definition needs to stay stable. The loaded content becomes executable SQL in your session, so choose a source you control or trust.
